name: Simple tidy CSV
notes: Baseline sanity check.

name: CSV with BOM
notes: Leading byte-order-mark should not break header detection.

name: CSV with quoted commas and embedded newlines
notes: Tests PapaParse quoting/escaping.

name: Semicolon-delimited CSV
notes: Non-comma delimiter should auto-detect.

name: Single-column CSV
notes: Previously rejected as 0 rows; findHeader() fallback to minCols=1 fixes this.

name: Single-column CSV with title row
content:
My Dataset Export

name
foo
bar
baz
notes: Checks the title row above a single-column header is skipped correctly.

name: Duplicate header names
notes: Later duplicate column silently wins (known minor limitation, not fixed).

name: Headerless numeric-only CSV
notes: First row is ambiguously treated as a header; known limitation.

name: Ragged CSV (inconsistent column counts)
notes: Missing/extra cells are dropped rather than crashing.

name: Empty CSV file
notes: PapaParse throws a delimiter-detection error; surfaced as an import error, not a crash.

name: All-blank-rows CSV
notes: Produces 0 usable rows; loadRows() throws a clean 'no rows found' error.

name: Wide-format CSV (years as columns)
notes: Auto-unpivots via pivotWide() into period/Health/Education/Transport and plots as a multi-line chart.

name: CSV with a trailing Total row
notes: Summary row is stripped before schema/guess so it doesn't skew stats or dominate the chart.

name: CSV with a Grand Total row
notes: Wider summary() regex catches 'Grand Total' as well as 'Total'.

name: High-cardinality categorical CSV (25 suburbs)
generator: suburb rows numbered 0-24 with descending population values
notes: truncateAggregate() collapses this to top 10 + an 'Other' bar for bar/doughnut/treemap charts.

name: Long-label categorical CSV (government department names)
content:
dept,budget
"Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water",500
"Department of Health and Aged Care",800
"Department of Education",300
"Attorney-Generals Department",200
notes: Labels longer than 15 characters trigger the horizontal bar (indexAxis:'y') auto-switch.

name: ID + numeric metric columns
notes: guess()/pickMetric() should avoid defaulting to the ID column as a plotted axis or metric.

name: JSON array of objects
notes: Baseline JSON ingestion.

name: JSON { data: [...] } wrapper
notes: Supported alternate top-level shape.

name: JSON with nested objects
notes: flatten() expands loc into loc_lat/loc_lng.

name: JSON array of arrays
notes: Treated as numerically-indexed columns (0,1,2); renders as a scatter chart.

name: Malformed JSON
notes: JSON.parse throws a clear syntax error surfaced to the user.

name: JSON single object (not an array)
notes: Rejected with 'JSON must be an array or a { data: [] } object.'

name: JSON array of primitives
notes: flatten() strips primitives to empty objects; loadRows() throws 'no rows found' cleanly.

name: JSON empty array
notes: Zero rows; handled without crashing.

name: JSON with null values
notes: blank() treats null as missing for schema/aggregation purposes.

name: JSON with an array-valued field
notes: Array fields are left intact (not flattened) and rendered via String() coercion; quirky but non-crashing.

name: num() parsing edge cases
notes: Leading-zero strings like postcodes (e.g. '00251') numerically parse to 251, losing the leading zero. Known display quirk, not fixed.
